name: Three Pillars
description: Structured development framework for Claude Code with design-first pipelines, multi-persona deliberation, and session continuity. Includes a full TDD pipeline (design → detailed design → plan → implement → audit), a spike pipeline for hypothesis-driven experiments, a Council of 18 historical thinker personas for complex decisions, and session management for continuity across conversations. 23 skills, 18 agents.
longDescription:
Ships **38 skills** and **20 agents**.

- **Skills** (38): `council` (Convene the Council of High Intelligence — multi-persona deliberation with historical thinkers for deeper analysis of complex problems), `tp-design` (Interactive high-level design conversation that produces a design.md artifact in three-pillars-docs/tp-designs/{name}/), `tp-design-audit` (Design Audit — multi-angle review of a detailed design against the actual codebase before implementation), `tp-design-complete` (Mark a TDD design as complete — stamp completion, archive handoff.md, archive to three-pillars-docs/completed-tp-designs/, and optionally commit +…), `tp-design-detail` (Produce a detailed-design.md from an existing design.md), `tp-design-learn` (Synthesize a completed design's impact into project docs updates and identify affected sibling designs), `tp-design-release` (Release your lock on a design without completing it), `tp-docs-init` (Scaffold architecture.md, product_roadmap.md, and known_issues.md in three-pillars-docs/ from codebase analysis), and 30 more
- **Agents** (20): `council-ada` (Council member), `council-aristotle` (Council member), `council-aurelius` (Council member), `council-feynman` (Council member), `council-kahneman` (Council member), `council-karpathy` (Council member), `council-lao-tzu` (Council member), `council-machiavelli` (Council member), and 12 more

Installs with `claude plugin install three-pillars@claude-community` from `CurtisThe/three-pillars-plugin`.
